result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Generate a Clean Architecture Web API project.

USAGE:
    dorn new webapi <name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Name of the project to generate

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help            Prints help information                               
    -o, --output          Output directory for the generated project. Defaults  
                          to ./<name>                                           
        --force           Overwrite existing files in the output directory      
        --database        Database provider: sqlite (default) or sqlserver.     
                          Prompted interactively if omitted and the session is  
                          interactive                                           
        --orchestrator    Orchestrator: aspire (default) or docker-compose.     
                          Prompted interactively if omitted and the session is  
                          interactive
